pages.quiz:
FRENCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does 'mercredi' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. Wednesday
   B. Saturday
   C. Tuesday
   D. Friday

2. How do you say 'good evening' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Monsieur
   B. bonsoir
   C. Enchanté
   D. merci

3. What does 'la salle de bain' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the bathroom
   B. the house
   C. the fridge
   D. the window

4. How do you say 'I have two hands.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. J'ai un nez.
   B. J'ai deux yeux.
   C. J'ai deux mains.
   D. Elle est petite.

5. How do you say 'Go' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Allez
   B. Excusez-moi
   C. Tournez
   D. De rien

6. What does 'Il est sur la table.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Turn left.
   B. Go straight ahead.
   C. It is on the table.
   D. The door is next to the window.

7. What does 'long' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. tall, big
   B. black
   C. short
   D. long

8. How do you say 'On Saturday, I play.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Le dimanche, je me repose.
   B. Le jeudi, je chante.
   C. Le samedi, je joue.
   D. Une semaine, sept jours.

9. What does 'J'ai deux pieds.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. I have two feet.
   B. I have two ears.
   C. I have two eyes.
   D. I have ten fingers.

10. How do you say the month 'April' in French? (1 mark)
   A. juin
   B. novembre
   C. avril
   D. juillet

11. How do you say 'behind' in French? (1 mark)
   A. sous
   B. sur
   C. derrière
   D. devant

12. What does 'Le samedi, j'aide ma mère.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. On Saturday, I help my mother.
   B. On Thursday, I sing.
   C. On Friday, I dance.
   D. Tomorrow it is Thursday.

13. What does 'J'ai neuf ans.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. There is a cake and there are balloons.
   B. I sing and I dance.
   C. I am nine years old.
   D. I am ten years old.

14. How do you say 'You are welcome!' in French? (1 mark)
   A. De rien !
   B. La télé est sur la table.
   C. Excusez-moi, où est l'école ?
   D. Tournez à droite.

15. Which little word goes with 'tomate' (the tomato)? (1 mark)
   A. l'
   B. la
   C. le
   D. les

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Translate into English: 'J'ai une bouche.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

17. Translate into French: 'Today it is raining.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

18. Translate into English: 'Aujourd'hui, il pleut.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

19. Translate into French: 'You are welcome!' (2 marks) (2 marks)

20. Translate into French: 'Put the book in the bedroom.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

21. Translate into French: 'It is a table.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

22. Translate into French: 'Good evening, Madam!' (2 marks) (2 marks)

FRENCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — Wednesday
   mercredi means Wednesday.

2. B — bonsoir
   good evening in French is bonsoir.

3. A — the bathroom
   la salle de bain means the bathroom.

4. C — J'ai deux mains.
   I have two hands. in French is J'ai deux mains.

5. A — Allez
   Go in French is Allez.

6. C — It is on the table.
   Il est sur la table. means It is on the table.

7. D — long
   long means long.

8. C — Le samedi, je joue.
   On Saturday, I play. in French is Le samedi, je joue.

9. A — I have two feet.
   J'ai deux pieds. means I have two feet.

10. C — avril
   April in French is avril.

11. C — derrière
   behind in French is derrière.

12. A — On Saturday, I help my mother.
   Le samedi, j'aide ma mère. means On Saturday, I help my mother.

13. C — I am nine years old.
   J'ai neuf ans. means I am nine years old.

14. A — De rien !
   You are welcome! in French is De rien !

15. B — la
   tomate is feminine, so we say la tomate.
